roadmap.step1Desc:
You just completed your first real coaching session.
Let me show you everything Mazo can do for you.
roadmap.step2Desc: 15+ coaches with unique styles — some are tough love, some are calm, some are strategic. Switch between them anytime from the Coach tab.
roadmap.step3Desc: Create a custom coach with the exact personality, tone, and goals you need. You can even share them with friends using a custom code.
roadmap.step4Desc: From the Coach Tab, tap "My Profile" to update your values, goals, and current focus. The more Mazo knows, the better your coaching gets.
roadmap.step5Desc: Insights from every session are automatically saved. Mazo will use what it learns about you in future conversations.
roadmap.step6Desc: The Journey tab is your home base — goals, tasks, schedule, memory, and community coaches all in one place.
roadmap.step7Desc:
Three tabs. That's it.
Coach, Journey, You.
Simple by design.
